description:
BiosSchema is the BIOS attribute registry discovered on one machine: which settings that machine's firmware actually has, what each one accepts, and which are read-only. It is written by the cluster, not by hand — it is how you find out what a BiosProfile is allowed to ask for.

Cluster-scoped, named after its Host and owned by it.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: BiosSchemaSpec is the discovered attribute registry of one host's BIOS. Like Asset it is spec-only — the object IS the data; nothing about it is derived further. Written by the convergence reconciler from the registry the Bios resource advertises (registry names are normalized on the client: the spelled identity differs between the Bios resource, the Registries member, and the file on both vendors).

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Attributes lists the registry's entries, sorted by name. Desired values in a materialized BiosSettings are validated against this before any operation is proposed — the machine would otherwise reject an unknown attribute at PATCH and silently drop an out-of-range value at apply.

fields.name: allowedValues
fields.description: AllowedValues enumerates the legal values; empty for non-enumerations.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type is the registry's attribute type: Enumeration, Boolean, Integer or String — kept as served.

fields.name: registry
fields.description: Registry is the registry identity as the Bios resource advertises it, kept verbatim (e.g. BiosAttributeRegistry.v1_0_0).
